description: A client player hit once by a zombie falls 30 blocks by its moves and dies of fall damage (#211): the fall damage of the move handler runs ServerPlayer.die, and the zombie that hurt it within 100 ticks gets the kill credit (killed_by zombie, entity_killed_player). All chunks in the players' simulation distance are forced (no asynchronous loads in Vanilla).
